crossRefs.note: Then he said to them, “Go your way. Eat the fat, drink the sweet, and send portions to him for whom nothing is…
Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.
Yahweh’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.
In all things I gave you an example, that so laboring you ought to help the weak, and to remember the words of the Lord…
On the first day of every week, let each one of you save, as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

translations.web: You shall furnish him liberally out of your flock, out of your threshing floor, and out of your wine press. As Yahweh your God has blessed you, you shall give to him.
translations.bsb: You are to furnish him liberally from your flock, your threshing floor, and your winepress. You shall give to him as the LORD your God has blessed you.
translations.kjv: Thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy floor, and out of thy winepress: of that wherewith the LORD thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give
translations.asv: thou shalt furnish him liberally out of thy flock, and out of thy threshing-floor, and out of thy winepress; as Jehovah thy God hath blessed thee thou shalt give unto him.
